defaults_checkip.description: IP address used for monitoring (default in code)

defaults_max_successive_pkts_lost.description: Maximum successive packets lost before alarm

defaults_min_packet_loss.description: Minimum packet loss percentage to trigger alert

defaults_min_successive_pkts_rcvd.description: Minimum successive packets received before declaring up

defaults_check_arp.description: Whether to check ARP (0 = no, 1 = yes)

defaults_sourceip.description: Source IP for probes (empty = system default)

defaults_ttl.description: TTL for probes (0 = use system default)

defaults_startup_acceleration.description: Number of successful probes before declaring up (0 = disabled)

defaults_startup_burst_pkts.description: Number of packets in initial burst (0 = disabled)

defaults_startup_burst_interval.description: Interval between burst packets in ms
